items.title: Japan’s centenarian population tops 100,000 for first time
items.summary: The number of people who are 100 or older per population of 100,000 stood at 87.51. By prefecture, Shimane logged 186.65, marking the highest figure for the 14th consecutive year, followed by Kochi’s 169.52 and Tottori’s 152.48.
